F-R46-1.measurement: tie pixel (7/16, 10/16, 0), level 128/255: pigment lum (binary32 blend_math::lum) 0x3f000000 = cut (level - 0.5/255) 0x3f000000 -> white. GPU lum bracketed by stepping the level bits so the kernel's own binary32 cut walks 0x3efffffb..0x3f000002: Vulkan white at cut 0x3effffff, black at 0x3f000000 -> GPU lum = 0x3effffff; DX12 white at 0x3f000000, black at 0x3f000001 -> GPU lum = 0x3f000000. 1110 8-bit real-arithmetic ties (30R + 59G + 11B = 12750): Vulkan 49, DX12 76 decided unlike pigment (pigment white 1030).
F-R46-1.cause: contraction into FMA (evidence, exact rational model fma-model-smb-r46-followups-1.py/.txt in the lane artifact folder): full contraction fma(0.11, b, fma(0.3, r, round(0.59 g))) reproduces Vulkan's 0x3effffff and its 49 exactly; fma(0.11, b, fma(0.59, g, round(0.3 r))) reproduces DX12's 0x3f000000 and its 76; none of the other four modelled evaluation orders (plain sum, one fused product with the second sum rounded, fma over the rounded first sum) matches either backend. naga 27.0.3 emits no NoContraction decoration (grep of back/spv). Which driver stage fuses is vendor behaviour: UNVERIFIED (D5).
F-R46-1.fix: kernel.wgsl threshold_lum: each product plus the runtime zero ext.adj[0].y (ext.rs writes params[0] = [level, 0, 0, 0] for Threshold), then ((p0 + p1) + p2): no product feeds a sum; a contracted fma(w, c, 0) rounds w c once like the plain product. Pigment unchanged, no golden changed, no tolerance touched. After: 0 of 1110 on both backends, tie lum 0x3f000000 on both.
